room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "ah-BEEL": a skillful girl paints her carved wooden duck bright orange, right down to A BILL: ah-BEEL ≈ A BILL: ah-BEEL ≈ A BILL
note: Skillful, clever (habile de ses mains = good with one's hands); can mean crafty, slick.

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "ah-DRWAH": a boy slides A DRAWER perfectly into the little cabinet he built himself: ah-DRWAH ≈ A DRAW(er): ah-DRWAH ≈ A DRAW(er)
note: Skillful, deft (adroit de ses mains = handy). Maladroit = clumsy. Literally 'to the right' (à droit): right-handed skill.

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "may-toh-DEEK": a girl sorts every screw by size into a neat row of jars, one METHOD, step by step: METHOD-EEK: may-toh-DEEK ≈ METHOD-EEK
note: Methodical, orderly; can mean plodding or fussy.

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "mah-lee-SYEUH": a grinning boy dangles a rubber spider over the bench to spook MOLLY, then waves: MOLLY, SEE YA!: mah-lee-SYEUH ≈ MOLLY, SEE YA
note: Mischievous, impish (un sourire malicieux = an impish grin). False friend: 'malicious' is malveillant.

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "an-say-pah-RAHBL": two little lovebirds snuggle on one perch and never part: INSEPARABLE: an-say-pah-RAHBL ≈ INSEPARABLE

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "voh-lew-mee-NEUH": a delivery man staggers in under a giant, bulky parcel twice his size: VOLUME-in-UH: voh-lew-mee-NEUH ≈ VOLUME-in-UH
note: Voluminous, bulky (un dossier volumineux = a thick file); of hair, full.

room_name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
hook: "fay-nay-AHN": a lazy teen FEIGNS sleep in the hammock every time someone needs help: FEIGN-AY-ON: feh-nay-AHN ≈ FEIGN-AY-ON
note: A lazybones, an idler (une fainéante); also an adjective, idle, lazy. Insulting when said of someone.

hook: "soh-lah-NEHL": in the choir, NELL sings with a very SOLEMN face: SOLEMN NELL: soh-lah-NEHL ≈ SOLEMN NELL
note: Solemn; also formal, ceremonious (une promesse solennelle, une séance solennelle).

hook: "PYEUH": an old man sits very still in his PEW, palms together, eyes closed: PEW-uh: PYEUH ≈ PEW-uh
note: Pious, devout. Un pieux mensonge = a white lie. Can sound sanctimonious when said ironically. Not the noun un pieu (a stake).

hook: "ay-loh-KAHN": a woman at the lectern speaks so well that people wipe a tear: ELOQUENT: ay-loh-KAHN ≈ ELOQUENT
note: Eloquent; also telling, that speaks for itself (un silence éloquent, des chiffres éloquents).

hook: "SOBR": a man in a plain gray coat sips only water: SOBER and simple: SOBR: SOBR ≈ SOBER
note: Sober (no alcohol, just water); also plain, understated (une robe sobre), restrained.

hook: "toh-lay-RAHN": the organist smiles and lets a toddler press one loud key mid-song: TOLERANT: toh-lay-RAHN ≈ TOLERANT
"zhahn-tee-YOM": a gentleman in a top hat tucks in the newborn's blanket and whispers 'GENTLY, MOM': zhahn-tee-YOM ≈ GENTLY, MOM: zhahn-tee-YOM ≈ GENTLY, MOM
note: Historically a nobleman (plural gentilshommes); today a gentleman, a man of fine manners. Old-fashioned.

hook: "noo-voh-NAY": a mother cradles her brand-NEW baby, NÉE (born) just this week, like 'née' on an announcement: NEW-voh-NAY: noo-voh-NAY ≈ NEW... NÉE (born)
note: A newborn (un nouveau-né, une nouveau-née); also an adjective, newborn (un agneau nouveau-né).
